subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
In a 2-bit digital to analog converter, reference
voltage used for logic ‘1’ is 5 V. If number of bits get
double keeping other quantities unchanged, then
which of the following is true?
(a)
Full scale voltage will change to 0.5 times the
initial value.
(b) Resolution will change to 0.5 times the initial
value.
(c)
Resolution will change to 0.2 times the initial
value.
(d) Full scale voltage will not change.
[NAT]

options.text: Full scale voltage will change to 0.5 times the
Resolution will change to 0.5 times the initial
Resolution will change to 0.2 times the initial
Full scale voltage will not change.

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-13 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 13).
